text: Neurons in an autonomic ganglion have dendrites. (Those in a sensory ganglion are PREGANGLIONIC FIBRES unipolar, having only an axon). (Thin myelinated axons from the brain POSTGANGLIONIC FIBERS stem or spinal cord) (Unmyelinated axons supplying smooth muscle and glands) Postganglionic fibres are more numerous than preganglionic fibres: An example of divergence.
